info.name: Hospital Management
info.description:
## Hospital Management API

This collection provides a comprehensive set of API endpoints for managing core hospital operations. It is designed to support the day-to-day workflows of healthcare facilities by enabling structured access to patient, staff, and administrative data.

### What's Covered
- **Patient Management** – Register, retrieve, update, and discharge patient records
- **Doctor & Staff Management** – Manage doctor profiles, specializations, and availability
- **Appointments** – Schedule, reschedule, and cancel patient appointments
- **Medical Records** – Access and update diagnoses, prescriptions, and treatment history
- **Billing & Invoicing** – Generate and manage patient bills and payment records
- **Ward & Bed Management** – Track bed availability and patient admissions

### Usage
Use this collection to test and integrate with the Hospital Management System backend. Ensure the appropriate environment is selected before sending requests, as base URLs and authentication tokens are managed via environment variables.
